plaatsen.tekst: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed
For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur
